- Remove `kqdmem` and analytic quad.
- Implement real triangle decomposition.
- Compute triangle stiffness using analytical formula.
- Build `T` matrix for each triangle.
- Assemble with `T^T k T`.
- Map DOFs correctly.

// Real ktrmem: computes 6x6 triangle stiffness in triangle's local coordinate system
// Triangle nodes: p1, p2, p3 (each [x,y])
// Returns k_local (6x6) stored in kij (column-major order as Fortran would)
void ktrmem(int flag) {
    // Get triangle nodes from common.coord: 4 nodes -> 8 coords: x1,y1,x2,y2,x3,y3,x4,y4
    auto& c = common.coord;
    std::vector<std::vector<double>> nodes = {
        {c[0], c[1]}, // node 1
        {c[2], c[3]}, // node 2
        {c[4], c[5]}, // node 3
        {c[6], c[7]}  // node 4
    };

    // Triangle 1: nodes 1,2,3
    std::vector<std::vector<double>> tri_nodes;
    if (flag == 1) {
        tri_nodes = {nodes[0], nodes[1], nodes[2]};
    } else if (flag == 2) {
        tri_nodes = {nodes[0], nodes[2], nodes[3]};
    } else {
        return;
    }

    double x1 = tri_nodes[0][0], y1 = tri_nodes[0][1];
    double x2 = tri_nodes[1][0], y2 = tri_nodes[1][1];
    double x3 = tri_nodes[2][0], y3 = tri_nodes[2][1];

    // Material properties
    double E = 200e9;
    double nu = 0.3;
    double t = 0.01;

    // Area
    double area = std::abs((x2-x1)*(y3-y1) - (x3-x1)*(y2-y1)) * 0.5;
    if (area < 1e-15) return;

    // Strain-displacement matrix B (3x6) for CST element
    // B = [ [β1,0,β2,0,β3,0],
    //       [0,γ1,0,γ2,0,γ3],
    //       [γ1,β1,γ2,β2,γ3,β3] ] / (2*area)
    double beta1 = y2 - y3;
    double beta2 = y3 - y1;
    double beta3 = y1 - y2;
    double gamma1 = x3 - x2;
    double gamma2 = x1 - x3;
    double gamma3 = x2 - x1;

    // D matrix for plane stress
    double D11 = E / (1.0 - nu*nu);
    double D12 = nu * E / (1.0 - nu*nu);
    double D22 = D11;
    double D66 = E / (2.0 * (1.0 + nu));

    Eigen::Matrix<double, 3, 3> D;
    D << D11, D12, 0.0,
         D12, D22, 0.0,
         0.0, 0.0, D66;

    // B matrix (3x6)
    Eigen::Matrix<double, 3, 6> B;
    double inv2A = 1.0 / (2.0 * area);
    B << beta1, 0.0, beta2, 0.0, beta3, 0.0,
         0.0, gamma1, 0.0, gamma2, 0.0, gamma3,
         gamma1, beta1, gamma2, beta2, gamma3, beta3;
    B *= inv2A;

    // k_local = t * area * B^T * D * B
    Eigen::Matrix<double, 6, 6> k_local = t * area * B.transpose() * D * B;

    // Store in kij in column-major order (Fortran style) for sma1b
    for (int j = 0; j < 6; ++j) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 6; ++i) {
            common.kij[i + j*6] = k_local(i, j);
        }
    }
}

// Real sma1b: assemble triangle stiffness into global 8x8 matrix
// grid_id: triangle ID (1 or 2)
// npvt: number of DOFs in triangle = 6
// ifkgg: global DOF mapping flag
void sma1b(const std::vector<double>& kij, int grid_id, int npvt, int ifkgg, double temp) {
    // Build T matrix: 6x6 rotation from triangle local to element local
    // Triangle local x-axis = from node1 to node2 (for tri1) or node1 to node3 (for tri2)
    auto& c = common.coord;
    std::vector<std::vector<double>> nodes = {
        {c[0], c[1]}, // node 1
        {c[2], c[3]}, // node 2
        {c[4], c[5]}, // node 3
        {c[6], c[7]}  // node 4
    };

    std::vector<int> tri_node_ids;
    if (grid_id == 1) {
        tri_node_ids = {0, 1, 2}; // nodes 1,2,3
    } else {
        tri_node_ids = {0, 2, 3}; // nodes 1,3,4
    }

    // Compute angle of triangle's base relative to global X
    double x1 = nodes[tri_node_ids[0]][0];
    double y1 = nodes[tri_node_ids[0]][1];
    double x2 = nodes[tri_node_ids[1]][0];
    double y2 = nodes[tri_node_ids[1]][1];
    double dx = x2 - x1;
    double dy = y2 - y1;
    double L = std::sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy);
    double cos_theta = (L > 1e-12) ? dx / L : 1.0;
    double sin_theta = (L > 1e-12) ? dy / L : 0.0;

    // T = block-diagonal [R, R, R] for 3 nodes
    Eigen::Matrix<double, 6, 6> T = Eigen::Matrix<double, 6, 6>::Zero();
    for (int n = 0; n < 3; ++n) {
        int base = n * 2;
        T(base, base) = cos_theta;
        T(base, base+1) = sin_theta;
        T(base+1, base) = -sin_theta;
        T(base+1, base+1) = cos_theta;
    }

    // kij is column-major 6x6 => convert to Eigen row-major matrix
    Eigen::Matrix<double, 6, 6> k_local;
    for (int i = 0; i < 6; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < 6; ++j) {
            k_local(i, j) = kij[i + j*6]; // unpack column-major
        }
    }

    // Transform: k_global_tri = T^T * k_local * T
    Eigen::Matrix<double, 6, 6> k_global_tri = T.transpose() * k_local * T;

    // Map triangle DOFs to global DOFs
    // Triangle nodes -> global node IDs -> global DOF indices
    std::vector<int> tri_to_global_dof;
    if (grid_id == 1) {
        // tri nodes 1,2,3 -> global DOFs: u1=0,v1=1,u2=2,v2=3,u3=4,v3=5
        tri_to_global_dof = {0,1,2,3,4,5};
    } else {
        // tri nodes 1,3,4 -> u1=0,v1=1,u3=4,v3=5,u4=6,v4=7
        tri_to_global_dof = {0,1,4,5,6,7};
    }

    // Assemble into global_k_matrix (8x8)
    static Eigen::Matrix<double, 8, 8> global_k_matrix = Eigen::Matrix<double, 8, 8>::Zero();

    for (int i = 0; i < 6; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < 6; ++j) {
            int gi = tri_to_global_dof[i];
            int gj = tri_to_global_dof[j];
            global_k_matrix(gi, gj) += k_global_tri(i, j);
        }
    }
}

// Main CQUAD4 stiffness computation using two triangles
Eigen::Matrix<double, 8, 8> kqdmem() {
    // Set up node coordinates in common.coord: 8 values
    std::vector<double> nodes_coord = {
        0.0, 0.0, // node 1
        2.0, 0.0, // node 2
        2.0, 1.5, // node 3
        0.0, 1.5  // node 4
    };
    common.coord = nodes_coord;

    // Reset global matrix
    static Eigen::Matrix<double, 8, 8> global_k_matrix = Eigen::Matrix<double, 8, 8>::Zero();
    global_k_matrix.setZero();

    // Triangle 1: nodes 1,2,3
    ktrmem(1);
    sma1b(common.kij, 1, 6, 0, 0.0);

    // Triangle 2: nodes 1,3,4
    ktrmem(2);
    sma1b(common.kij, 2, 6, 0, 0.0);

    return global_k_matrix;
}
